A tile puzzle is not a trivia quadrant grid, but tile-grid is the only tiled-floor row in the catalogue; the ID's published meaning and the use I put it to barely overlap.

notes_for_us: Two sentences of a very long prompt are layout and the rest is animation scripting. Triage handled it cleanly and mechanics is where the bulk went, which is the design working — but the handoff gives no signal that the user will judge this build on the animations, not the map.
'With real doors' is the entire basis for P3 here. A single adjective flipping a pipeline modifier is correct per the read-for-the-feature rule and also very easy to miss.

The three named moves have real spatial requirements — a 360 sweep needs clearance, a dash needs a straight, knockback needs somewhere to fly. Nothing in the handoff can state a required clear floor area, so the map may well not have room for the moves it was built for.
